subject: Bluepoint Health kickoff — onboarding plan and technical notes
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bluepoint Health kickoff — initial handoff and runbook

Hi Hannah —

Putting Bluepoint Health over to you for CS intake and kickoff planning. Quick context: this is a $120k ARR deal (annualized), signed this morning. Go-live target is 2026-06-21 (pilot) with full production by 2026-08-01 if pilot metrics meet acceptance.

What matters operationally:
- Expected steady-state usage: ~120k tokens/day; spikes up to ~800k tokens/day during business hours (US-Eastern).
- Traffic profile: 95% generation/chat, 5% embeddings for search.
- Latency SLO requested: median <120ms token latency; we discussed starting on Hosted API and moving to Dedicated capacity after pilot for predictable latency.
- Security: Bluepoint requires SOC2 attestation and an audit log export cadence (monthly). They will want a KMS-backed key for logging — Procurement asked about HSM/KMS integration.
- Integrations: SSO (Okta), SCIM provisioning, and TLS mutual auth for backend ingestion endpoints.
- Data policy: default retention 30 days; they asked about optional 90-day retention for debug windows.

Attached: onboarding MOP (play-by-play), SOW draft, and a short spreadsheet with system constraints reported by their infra team.

Immediate asks for CS team:
1) Confirm CS lead and responder for weekly syncs (I recommend Tessa Morgan as primary).
2) Estimate runbook work: identity, network allowlist, test dataset ingestion, smoke-test prompts.
3) Flag any blockers for HIPAA adjacency — they process some PHI-adjacent metadata; want to confirm whether Private deployment will be required later.

I'll be on the kickoff but want the CS team to drive timelines. Samir (Bluepoint) is the product owner and Anita (engineering lead) will own the infra items. Procurement contact is procurement@bluepointhealth.com.

Thanks —
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bluepoint Health kickoff — initial handoff and runbook

Thanks Marissa — useful summary. Looping in a few clarifying questions so we can scope the kickoff and internal owners:

1) For the pilot: is the plan to use the Hosted API with a production-like traffic replay, or will Bluepoint provision Dedicated capacity from day one (they mentioned cost sensitivity but care about latency consistency)?
2) Can you confirm the expected QPS/peak concurrent sessions during the spike windows? The token numbers are helpful but we need concurrent session estimates for autoscaling config.
3) On SSO/SCIM: do they have a test Okta tenant ready for the pilot, or do we need to provision a staging SAML connector?
4) HIPAA adjacency: is PHI present in prompt text or only in metadata? If PHI is in prompts we will need to escalate to Security for Private deployment guidance and legal review.
5) Any preferred candidates for who on our side should be the technical owner for network allowlist coordination? I can take point, but if Dev prefers to own the firewall/ingress items let us know.

I'll slot a 60-minute internal intake tomorrow at 10:00 PT to draft the runbook and gather owners — invite to follow.

Thanks,
Hannah

Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bluepoint Health kickoff — initial handoff and runbook

Hannah — answers inline below. Sharing a slightly updated SOW draft (minor clarifications) and a short ops checklist.

1) Pilot environment: Bluepoint prefers Hosted API for the pilot (faster onboarding). They will commit to Dedicated by the production launch if pilot latency shows variability. So plan: Hosted -> Pilot -> Dedicated migration (targeted for post-2026-06 pilot review).
2) Peak concurrency: Anita reports ~60 concurrent user sessions during spikes; average concurrent sessions ~8 during steady state. Peak RPS ~45 at peak (chat messages with batching).
3) Okta: they have an Okta test tenant; Anita can share admin creds with our integration engineer in a secure vault.
4) PHI details: Samir confirms prompts will NOT contain PHI; only metadata (user IDs, pseudonymized tokens). Legal has okayed proceeding on Hosted but requested we capture policy options for 90-day retention and Private deployment if anything changes.
5) Network allowlist: Dev can own firewall-rule coordination; I'll ask Anita to provide IP ranges.

Procurement timeline: they need a final SOW signed and PO by 2026-05-20 to keep original start dates. They asked for the SOC2 report and last 6 months uptime summary — attached links in doc.

Next steps (immediate):
- Hannah to run intake and draft runbook (identity, test data ingestion plan, smoke-test checklist).
- Dev to confirm network allowlist window and ingress requirements.
- Karthik to prepare kickoff agenda and acceptance metrics for pilot.
- I will schedule an external kickoff with Samir/Anita for 2026-05-10 (will send Doodle).

Attachments: updated SOW and short ops checklist.

Thanks,
Marissa

--
